GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which words are always written with a capital letter in German? (1 mark)
   A. Adjectives
   B. Small words like und
   C. Verbs
   D. Nouns

2. Which German word or phrase means "no"? (1 mark)
   A. Nein
   B. Hallo
   C. Sehr gut
   D. Auf Wiedersehen

3. Which German word means "tall or big"? (describing people) (1 mark)
   A. jung
   B. lustig
   C. groß
   D. nett

4. Which German word or phrase means "friend"? (1 mark)
   A. die Schwester
   B. der Freund
   C. die Geschwister
   D. der Opa

5. Which German word or phrase means "shower"? (1 mark)
   A. die Wand
   B. der Tisch
   C. der Kühlschrank
   D. die Dusche

6. What is the plural of "die Lampe"? (1 mark)
   A. die Lampen
   B. die Lampes
   C. die Lamper
   D. die Lampe

7. Which German word means "to cook"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. sehen
   B. kochen
   C. riechen
   D. spielen

8. Which verb fits in "Am Sonntag ___ ich in die Kirche"? (1 mark)
   A. gehen
   B. gehe
   C. geht
   D. gehst

9. How many words are in the third line of an Elfchen? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 3
   D. 4

10. Which German word or phrase means "song"? (1 mark)
   A. das Lied
   B. das Geschenk
   C. die Kerze
   D. der Kuchen

11. What does "der siebte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. first
   B. second
   C. seventh
   D. eighth

12. Which German word or phrase means "egg"? (1 mark)
   A. das Mittagessen
   B. das Ei
   C. der Kakao
   D. die Banane

13. Which little word goes with the noun "Banane"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

14. Which German word or phrase means "head"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kopf
   B. das Gesicht
   C. das Haar
   D. der Rücken

15. Which plural has an umlaut? (1 mark)
   A. die Augen
   B. die Ohren
   C. die Beine
   D. die Füße

16. Which little word goes with the noun "Nase"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. die
   D. den

17. Which word is written with a capital letter? (1 mark)
   A. kalt
   B. windig
   C. warm
   D. Regen

18. Which German word means "sunny"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. kalt
   B. sonnig
   C. trocken
   D. heiß

19. What does "hinter der Tür" mean? (1 mark)
   A. in front of the door
   B. behind the door
   C. next to the door
   D. on the door

20. What does "zwischen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. between
   B. under
   C. on
   D. in front of

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write a menu for one day in German with three meals. (3 marks)

22. Write three sentences in German that say where things are in your room. (3 marks)

23. Explain why you should use reliable sources when you research a famous person's birthday. (2 marks)

24. Write the German words with der, die or das for: sugar, child, sofa. (3 marks)

25. Write the German words with der, die or das for: shoulder, son. (2 marks)

26. Write the forms of "haben" for ich, du and er. (3 marks)

27. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cupboard or wardrobe, weather, back. (3 marks)

28. Write the German words with der, die or das for: balloon, arm, sister, shoulder. (4 marks)

29. Unscramble and write with der or die: STWECHERS. (2 marks)

30. Write the German words with der, die or das for: fish, living room, rain. (3 marks)

31. Write the German words with der, die or das for: room, sun. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Nouns
   All German nouns begin with capital letters.

2. A — Nein
   no in German is Nein.

3. C — groß
   tall or big in German is groß.

4. B — der Freund
   friend in German is der Freund.

5. D — die Dusche
   shower in German is die Dusche.

6. A — die Lampen
   The plural of die Lampe is die Lampen.

7. B — kochen
   to cook in German is kochen.

8. B — gehe
   ich goes with gehe.

9. C — 3
   The lines have 1, 2, 3, 4 and 1 words.

10. A — das Lied
   song in German is das Lied.

11. C — seventh
   der siebte means seventh.

12. B — das Ei
   egg in German is das Ei.

13. C — die
   It is die Banane, so the little word is die.

14. A — der Kopf
   head in German is der Kopf.

15. D — die Füße
   Fuß becomes Füße.

16. C — die
   It is die Nase, so the little word is die.

17. D — Regen
   Regen is a noun. Adjectives are small.

18. B — sonnig
   sunny in German is sonnig.

19. B — behind the door
   hinter means behind.

20. A — between
   zwischen means between.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Frühstück: Tee und Brot. Mittagessen: Reis und Bohnen. Abendessen: Ugali und Fisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meal correctly written.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist an der Wand. Der Tisch ist neben dem Bett. Die Tasche ist unter dem Tisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: Some information is wrong; reliable sources have been checked.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Zucker, das Kind, das Sofa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Schulter, der Sohn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: ich habe, du hast, er hat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct form.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Schrank, das Wetter, der Rücken.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Luftballon, der Arm, die Schwester, die Schulter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the article.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Fisch, das Wohnzimmer, der Regen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Zimmer, die Sonne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).
